subject: Eval kickoff / technical deep-dive — proposed times & success criteria
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Anita Ramesh <anita@finexus.com>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@finexus.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>

Subject: Eval kickoff / technical deep-dive — proposed times & success criteria

Hi Anita / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — helpful conversation and good alignment on the main goals. Short recap and proposed next step (kickoff + tech deep-dive to scope the evaluation environment):

Recap (from our discovery):
- Primary objective: evaluate latency and cost trade-offs for your agent and customer-facing summarization pipelines.
- Target workload: 1k concurrent inference sessions, typical prompt lengths 120–300 tokens, peak bursts up to 500 QPS for short windows.
- Success criteria (draft): average p95 latency < 250ms, per-token cost <= $0.0008, no production-impacting errors over a 2-week run.

Proposal: schedule a 60-minute "Eval kickoff + technical deep-dive" where we:
1) Review the trial plan (scope, infra, model variants)
2) Confirm success criteria and acceptance tests
3) Walk through prompt set / eval harness and data access
4) Align on timeline, milestones, and responsible owners

Proposed slots (PT):
- Thu 2026-03-26 10:00–11:00 PT
- Fri 2026-03-27 09:00–10:00 PT
- Mon 2026-03-30 13:00–14:00 PT

If none of those work, send two preferred windows and we'll align. I've attached a short draft of the trial plan to help the conversation.

Attachments: trial_plan_draft.pdf (draft scope & timeline)

Next internal steps on our side: I'll loop Grace (solutions) and Aditya (AE lead) into the kickoff; Grace will run the technical deep-dive and can bring an SRE if you want deeper infra discussion.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

—
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

A couple of questions for the kickoff so we can prep the right folks:
- Can you confirm where the trial sandbox will run (AWS us-west-2 or Redwood-hosted)? We have data residency requirements for some customer PII.
- Do you have a current SOC2 report or an SOC2 letter we can review before the kickoff?
- We'll include our SRE (Tom) and our Security lead on the kickoff if possible.

Also: can you add a short list of what you consider the top three acceptance tests so we can align expectations? The p95 latency / cost numbers are useful but we typically also want to lock on functional quality thresholds (ROUGE/BLEU-ish metrics or human eval pass rates).

Thanks — Anita
